firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support a wine showcase website with a blog and admin dashboard. It prioritizes Authorization Independence by avoiding `get()` calls in security rules. This is achieved through structural segregation and path-based ownership where appropriate. The structure facilitates listing operations with QAPs by ensuring collections contain homogenous documents with consistent security requirements. 

Specifically, access control for wine products is public read, write-access to admins only via the `wines` collection. Similarly, blog posts (`blogPosts`) and categories are publicly readable and admin-writable. Contact messages (`contacts`) and newsletter subscriptions (`newsletterSubscriptions`) are write-only for all users. An admin-only collection (`roles_admin`) grants elevated privileges based on document existence. This enables independent rule evaluation without hierarchical dependencies, enhancing security, scalability and debuggability.
